title: Perimeter of an Ellipse: Understanding Ramanujan's Approximation
summary: It is well known that there is no closed form analytic expression for the perimeter of an ellipse. In 1927, Srinivasa Ramanujan provides two approximations to the perimeter of an ellipse that are amazingly accurate. However, he does not provide an explanation of how he arrived at those expressions. In this paper, we will try to provide such an explanation that is likely how he derived those expressions.
